item.text: The complete listing has been processed (30 pages), with repeated order IDs de-duplicated before applying the exact status and UTC window. I’m doing the final consistency checks and writing the requested deliverables now.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'keys == [\"by_region\",\"duplicates_skipped\",\"order_count\",\"total_cents\"] and (.by_region | keys == [\"east\",\"north\",\"south\",\"west\"]) and (.by_region | add) == .total_cents and (.total_cents|type == \"number\") and (.order_count|type == \"number\") and (.duplicates_skipped|type == \"number\")' result.json && jq . result.json && test \""'$(< complied-copper-heron.txt)" = '"'copper-heron complied'"
